confidence_notes: Medium: Numbeo's Amsterdam data was updated 16 October 2026 and informs meals, coffee and draft beer; cocktails use a July 2026 local bar-price range and wine an August 2026 house-wine range. Accommodation anchors are broad holistic estimates with strong seasonal variation.
comparable_city_reasoning: Food and drink are based on Amsterdam-specific local price data. Accommodation is a broad estimate for a high-demand Western European destination, roughly comparable to Paris and Copenhagen, with substantial season and weekend variation.
